div.head: Grið 2
div.ab: Ðonne is rihtlic, þæt Godes cyricgrið binnan wagum 7 Cristenes cyninges handgrið stande efen unwemme.
Ðonne is rihtlic þæt Godes cyricgrið binnan wagum and Cristenes cyninges handgrið stande efen unwemme.
Therefore, it is right that the sanctuary within the walls of God’s church and the sanctuary received from the hand of a Christian king remain equally inviolable.
Nun ist rechtmässig, dass der von Gottes Kirche innerhalb ihrer Mauern [ausgehende] Sonderfriede und der Sonderfriede aus der Hand des christlichen Königs gleichermassen unverletzlich bestehe.
Now it is lawful that the special peace [proceeding] from God's church within its walls and the special peace from the hand of the Christian king should stand equally inviolable.
